kwlcathedral_guide.text: Welcome to St Magnus Cathedral, the most northerly cathedral in Britain. Please use your indoor voice and your outdoor manners.
Earl Rognvald started it in 1137 in memory of his uncle Magnus. Red and yellow sandstone make stripes in the pillars, like a very holy sweet shop.
In 1919 workers found a box of bones inside one of the pillars. They are thought to be those of St Magnus himself.

kwlcathedral_student.text: I am training to be a guide. So far I can tell you where the toilets are and where not to run.
